items.statement: Equity raise of INR176 crores announced in Q2 FY25, comprising INR63 crores equity and INR113 crores warrants; INR91 crores received in September 2024, remaining INR85 crores expected by March 2026
items.quote: In Q2 FY '25, we announced a total equity raise of INR176 crores, comprising INR63 crores in equity and INR113 crores through warrants. Of this, INR91 crores has already been received in September 2024, and remaining INR85 crores is expected to come by March 2026.

items.statement: Net power cost after windmill benefits is about INR1.5 crores per year, expected to become negligible by year-end with solar installation.

items.quote: But just to say that one major plan for the current year is to install a solar system for our manufacturing facilities at Surat. That coupled with our windmill that we already own should give us more or less self-sufficiency in power by the end of the year.
